widgets_values:
You are a senior fashion product strategist,
technical designer, and e-commerce art director developing an original new
product for the AZAZIE website.

Infer the homogeneous product category from the current competitor and optional
product evidence. Analyze only what is supplied in this run. Do not assume a
specific style name, neckline, drape path, waist treatment, surface technique,
or hem construction before reviewing the evidence.

Create three genuinely different, manufacturable concepts:
- Candidate A: commercially safe and broadly wearable.
- Candidate B: trend-forward with balanced commercial risk.
- Candidate C: visually bold but still suitable for repeatable production.

Select the strongest one in the same response using originality, category fit,
AZAZIE presentation fit, size inclusivity, manufacturing clarity, and likely
e-commerce appeal. The three proposals must differ structurally rather than
being color or trim variations of one design.

[CREATIVE STRENGTH]
大胆原创
允许更鲜明的结构语言和更强视觉记忆点，但不得牺牲人体合理性、尺码包容性与可重复生产。

[USER CREATIVE DIRECTION]
未指定额外方向；请完全根据本次竞品与可选商品证据动态判断。

[V3 FIXED CREATIVE CONTRACT - CANNOT BE OVERRIDDEN]
The supplied competitor is evidence and inspiration only. The optional product
source is a category, fit, material, color, or catalog anchor only. Never copy a
recognizable combination of pattern pieces, construction paths, embellishment
placement, logos, text, watermarks, model identity, pose sequence, page layout,
or trade dress.

Every candidate must transform four comparison dimensions:
1. neckline and shoulder architecture;
2. surface treatment, texture, or drape path;
3. waist-to-hip focal construction;
4. skirt and hem geometry.

Candidates A, B, and C must be structurally distinct. Every pair must differ in
at least three of the four dimensions above. A color change, fabric swap, trim
change, or accessory change does not count as a structural difference.

The selected proposal must remain manufacturable, size-inclusive, visually
clear in e-commerce imagery, and suitable for a white or light-gray AZAZIE
studio. Use attached images and supplied page metadata only as evidence. Put
all interpretation, prediction, trend judgment, design invention, and
marketing hypotheses under AI inference fields.
Treat hero_product_hooks as testable merchandising hypotheses, never as a
guarantee that a design will become a best seller.

Completion and compactness rules:
- the complete JSON must not exceed 6500 Unicode characters;
- close every array and the outer object before adding optional detail;
- use compact JSON without Markdown, commentary, or pretty-print indentation;
- competitor/product fact and inference lists: at most 3 items each;
- every candidate selling_points and hero_product_hooks list: 1-2
  concise items;
- selected_reference_mapping: 1-2 items;
- selected_manufacturing_risks: at most 2 items;
- each list item: at most 32 Chinese characters or 90 English characters;
- each design_analysis: at most 160 Chinese characters;
- each commercial_positioning and design_concept: at most 80 Chinese
  characters; each product_spec or originality_delta value: at most 40;
- selection_reason: at most 140 Chinese characters;
- do not return brand_characteristics, originality_delta, hero_prompt,
  negative_prompt, selected_chinese_brief, or eight_view_plan. The V3 node
  derives those deterministic fields locally.

Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown or commentary:
{
  "selected_competitor_indices": [1, 2],

  "category_assessment": {

Index and evidence rules:
- select 1-3 competitor images;
- when a product source exists, select 1-2 product images;

  product_analysis may be omitted because the node inserts safe local values;

widgets_values:
[V3 FIXED GENERATION CONTRACT - HIGHEST PRIORITY]
The automatic plan contains one selected original candidate. That selected
candidate is authoritative. Do not import structural details from either
unselected candidate, and do not reconstruct a recognizable competitor design.

IMAGE 1 is the product or category anchor. Later images are design evidence.
Create a new, manufacturable garment in the same inferred product category.
Preserve coherent anatomy, realistic fit, credible seams, material behavior,
and one consistent model identity.

Generate exactly one landscape composite as a strict 4-column x 2-row grid of
eight equal portrait panels. Fixed row-major order:
1 front full body; 2 left-front three-quarter full body; 3 strict left profile
full body; 4 strict back full body; 5 strict right profile full body; 6
right-front three-quarter lightly dynamic full body; 7 front half body framed
from head through mid-thigh; 8 back half body framed from head through
mid-thigh.

All panels must show the exact same selected garment, model, target color,
material, construction, seam map, hem length, styling, studio, lighting, and
color management. Only pose and required camera angle may change.

Use equal panel geometry. Do not produce missing, merged, duplicated, inset, or
overlapping views. Render no labels, numbers, captions, borders, separators,
logo, brand text, watermark, printed interface, or any other text. Avoid extra
garments, broken anatomy, duplicated limbs, fused fabric, impossible seams,
floating details, and cross-view design drift.

[SELECTED AUTOMATIC DESIGN PLAN]

{automatic_prompt}

nodes.title: V12 入参6｜8路指定模型仅高清完整 Prompt｜严格锁定原构图｜禁止缩放/裁切/重构
widgets_values:
High-resolution detail restoration only. The composition is
coordinate-locked to the uploaded image. Preserve the exact crop, framing,
camera position, camera angle, perspective, subject scale, subject position,
headroom, footroom, negative space, background horizon and every garment edge
at the same normalized x/y coordinates.

Do not crop, zoom, pan, recenter, rotate, tilt, warp, widen, narrow, extend or
recompose the image. Do not move the model, face, hands, feet, dress, hem,
train, shadows or background. Do not change pose, anatomy, silhouette,
neckline, straps, sleeves, draping, pleats, seams, closures, color, print,
lighting or styling. Do not redesign, add, remove or invent any element.

Improve only genuine high-frequency detail: textile micro-texture, seam and
edge definition, natural skin and hair detail, restrained sharpness and clean
commercial product-photo clarity. Keep large shapes, tonal masses and spatial
relationships unchanged. No text, logo, watermark, frame, border, letterbox,
color strip or hard transition.

cloudsway_v13_design_points.competitor_summary: 竞品为浅柠檬黄色抹胸长礼服，核心语言集中在直筒包身轮廓、横向褶裥胸衣、腰臀斜向垂褶与高开衩组合，呈现度假晚宴/派对礼服感，视觉卖点明确但结构和开衩风险较高。
cloudsway_v13_design_points.product_summary: 本品为浅粉底大花印花抹胸中长连衣裙，核心识别点集中在无肩带直领、贴合上身、腰部抽褶放量及柔软垂坠的花卉裙摆。优势是度假感、浪漫感和拍照氛围明确；可升级空间在于抹胸结构、花型差异化与腰部褶量控制，避免常见碎花抹胸裙同质化。

points.title: 包身长裙
points.description: 整体为贴身抹胸长裙，胸腰臀线条收窄，裙长及地，正面呈修长柱形轮廓。
points.design_value: 可借鉴其纵向拉长比例和贴体礼服感，用于强化女性化、正式场景的产品定位。
points.risk_note: 贴身长裙对尺码包容度和腰臀合体要求高，易暴露身形差异。

points.title: 平口抹胸
points.description: 上身采用无肩带平口抹胸，领口横向平直，完整露出肩颈和锁骨区域。
points.design_value: 可作为晚宴、度假、派对类连衣裙的高露肤识别点，突出肩颈线条。
points.risk_note: 抹胸结构需防滑和支撑，生产上需要内衬、胶骨或防滑条配合，否则穿着安全感不足。

points.title: 横向褶裥
points.description: 胸衣部分有多道细密横向褶裥，从领口下方延伸至高腰位置，形成包裹式层次。
points.design_value: 可借鉴横褶增加胸衣区域的视觉厚度与精致感，并改善浅色面料的单薄感。
points.risk_note: 褶裥间距和张力若处理不均，容易显廉价或造成胸部横向膨胀。

points.title: 斜向垂褶
points.description: 腰臀部从一侧向另一侧形成斜向聚拢垂褶，褶量集中在胯侧并向裙身下方展开。
points.design_value: 可借鉴斜向褶线修饰腹部和胯部，同时制造动态包裹感。
points.risk_note: 该褶裥结构识别度很高，直接复刻存在抄袭风险；褶量控制不当会显胯宽。

points.title: 高开衩
points.description: 前侧偏一边设置高开衩，开衩高度接近大腿上部，走动时露出腿部。
points.design_value: 可借鉴侧前开衩提升活动量和性感度，适合礼服及派对场景。
points.risk_note: 开衩过高会影响安全感和商业接受度，需考虑内里遮挡及不同身高穿着效果。

points.title: 柔软垂感
points.description: 面料表面平滑、轻薄，有明显顺垂效果，褶裥处能形成柔和弧线而非硬挺折痕。
points.design_value: 可参考使用具有垂坠感的梭织或弹力面料来承接斜向褶裥和长裙垂线。
points.risk_note: 浅色柔软面料易透、易显内衣痕迹，对里布和克重要求较高。

points.title: 淡柠黄
points.description: 整件为低饱和浅黄色，颜色明亮柔和，配合露肤和长礼服轮廓呈现清爽度假感。
points.design_value: 可借鉴浅亮色提升夏季、婚礼宾客或度假场景的视觉吸引力。
points.risk_note: 浅黄对肤色适配有门槛，也更容易显脏和透底。

points.title: 拍照出片
points.description: 抹胸露肩、腰臀垂褶和高开衩共同形成强正面视觉焦点，静态站姿下腿部和腰线突出。
points.design_value: 可提炼为适合社交媒体传播的礼服卖点，强调上镜、显腿长和腰臀修饰。
points.risk_note: 强造型单品日常穿着场景有限，库存需谨慎评估目标客群和场合需求。

points.title: 抹胸直领
points.description: 上身为无肩带抹胸结构，前胸口近水平直线，肩颈与锁骨完全外露，背部同样为无肩带露背效果。
points.design_value: 这是本品最强识别点之一，可延续其清爽、度假、晚装感的露肩视觉，用于强化女性化和夏季场景。
points.risk_note: 抹胸款对胸围支撑、防滑和上身贴合要求高，量产需注意内衬、胶骨或防滑条设计；直接复刻直线抹胸易同质化。

points.title: 上紧下摆
points.description: 整体呈上身贴合、腰部收住、下摆自然放开的A字廓形，裙长至脚踝上方，行走时裙摆有轻盈摆量。
points.design_value: 该廓形适合延续为主线轮廓，兼具修饰上半身和遮盖下半身的商业友好度，适合度假裙、婚礼宾客裙等场景。
points.risk_note: A字印花抹胸连衣裙市场常见，若廓形比例无变化，容易缺少新品辨识度。

points.title: 柔垂薄料
points.description: 面料呈轻薄柔软状态，裙摆褶皱自然下垂，局部有细腻光泽感，印花在面料上显得柔和不厚重。
points.design_value: 可作为保留的穿着体验方向，适合营造飘逸、浪漫、夏季轻盈感，并提升动态效果。
points.risk_note: 轻薄面料可能存在透底、勾丝或抗皱性不足问题，需要关注里布、克重与成衣支撑。

points.title: 粉色花卉
points.description: 底色为浅粉或裸粉调，表面分布粉、玫瑰、橘粉及浅绿色叶片的大花图案，整体色调柔和甜美。
points.design_value: 粉色花卉是本品浪漫度假感的主要来源，可延续柔和暖粉色系与花卉主题来保持客群认知。
points.risk_note: 粉色花卉长裙较容易与市场同类产品相似，花型、比例或配色需要重做以避免复制感。

points.title: 高腰抽褶
points.description: 腰线位于自然腰偏高位置，从腰部向下有密集纵向抽褶和放量，前后均能看到褶量集中后形成裙摆展开。
points.design_value: 高腰抽褶能拉长腿部比例并增加裙摆容量，是提升包容性和浪漫感的有效结构，可作为可延续卖点。
points.risk_note: 腰部褶量过多可能显腹部臃肿，生产中需控制抽褶分布和腰围松量。

points.title: 及踝裙摆
points.description: 裙摆长度接近及踝，前后均为长款落地感但不完全拖地，底摆呈柔和弧形展开。
points.design_value: 及踝长度强化优雅度和度假场景，也利于承接轻薄面料的飘动效果，可作为中高客单连衣裙方向。
points.risk_note: 长裙对不同身高适配存在风险，可能需要考虑尺码分档或长度版本。

points.title: 后背贴合
points.description: 后背上口平直，衣身贴合背部，腰部后中区域可见收省或拼接线痕迹，帮助抹胸上身固定。
points.design_value: 后背贴合结构有助于保持抹胸稳定和整体利落感，可作为版型支撑重点继续优化。
points.risk_note: 若后背上口过紧会勒肉，过松则易下滑；不同胸背差异会带来试穿风险。

points.title: 度假浪漫
points.description: 露肩抹胸、粉色花卉、轻盈长裙摆共同形成明显的海岛度假、婚礼宾客或夏日晚宴氛围。
points.design_value: 可作为商品企划中的核心场景卖点，适合视觉营销、度假系列和礼服化日装定位。
points.risk_note: 场景感较强，日常通勤适用度有限，若目标客群偏实穿需增加可穿性设计。

product_design_v9.upstream_node_classes: V0.8 exact through splitter; V9 crop-safe GP-HD at node31

notes: 默认文本逐字沿用V9，默认AI请求效果不变。
编辑任何Prompt后，对应模型阶段的效果会随之变化。
删除高清Prompt中的4:5安全区规则可能造成最终裁剪截断。
云端生成存在随机性，请求相同不等于像素逐点相同。

product_design_v11.base_workflow: V10版本-大模型入参全部可编辑_AI效果沿用V9.json
notes: V11不再输出4:5 2048x2560，因为改变宽高比必然裁切或补边。
GPT候选仅提供受限高频细节，原图始终控制低频、轮廓和构图。
构图检测失败或API失败时，逐槽回退为原图LANCZOS 2X。

product_design_v12.base_workflow: 自动化选品_V11_高清只增强不改构图_原比例2X_最终1140x1578.json
notes: V12只替换逐图高清引擎，规划与GP Image 2母版生成保持V11不变。
指定高清模型使用Gemini原生generateContent，不调用images/edits。
远端结果仅提供受限高频细节，原图始终控制构图和低频。
API或构图检测失败时，逐槽回退为原图LANCZOS原比例2X。

interaction: 第一次运行：分别分析竞品与本品并刷新设计点按钮。

不选择时必须点击跳过，流程才会继续。
